control_layers.application: Define entity semantics, intended unit, source criteria, acquisition budget, pipeline consumption point, acceptance checks, alternative branches, and stop rule.
control_layers.execution: Query or download the selected resource, preserve provenance and license, validate mappings, expose exact rows/relations used, and report failures or conflicts.
control_layers.theory: Decide whether the gap matters to the question and whether resource acquisition can change the evidence or use decision.

current_state.next_state: planned_for_future model-topic iteration after current Yeast follow-up; use Splice only after its trigger is met

entity_rules.family_granularity: Define for the target question and data source; a name, accession, or sequence cluster is not automatically a biological family.
entity_rules.proxy_labels: Exact-sequence, similarity, or name-token groups remain labeled as proxies and do not become gene-independent groups by relabeling.
entity_rules.relation_cardinality: Preserve one-to-many and many-to-many edges. Collapse only under an explicit, justified transformation that records discarded alternatives.
entity_rules.thresholds: Coverage, conflict tolerance, and budget are instantiated per question before examining downstream model outcomes; no universal numeric cutoff is imposed.
entity_rules.unknowns: Unmapped or ambiguous identifiers are unknown/ambiguous, never implicit negatives.
entity_rules.partial_mapping: Report mapped and unmapped subgroup composition and any changed sample population; compare evaluation designs on common records where appropriate, keeping mapping selection effects distinct from grouping effects.
entity_rules.source_agreement: Agreement between matching outputs is a consistency observation. Document the independent anchors, source evidence or manual checks supporting the biological relation under the selected use.

evidence_binding.result_link: source record -> typed mapping relation -> exact code/config consumer -> split/evaluation rows -> changed results -> decision/revision

future_model_topic_pilot.inputs_to_acquire: A suitable versioned identifier/entity mapping and its provenance, coverage, and license; exact source remains unselected pending the question and source check.
future_model_topic_pilot.legal_alternative: If a reliable mapping is unavailable or too incomplete for the selected purpose, retain proxy language and narrow the claim, or stop the gene/family-level question.
planned_comparison: retain existing sequence/name proxy split as the historical comparator
construct a biologically typed split only from verified mapping relations
report mapped, unmatched, ambiguous, and conflicting units
compare evaluation units and outcomes under a predeclared acceptance rule
future_model_topic_pilot.trigger: A later research question claims gene-level or family-level generalization, or requires those entities as independent evaluation units.

mapping_unavailable: Continue with existing proxy unit and narrow the claim.
Use a different versioned source if it resolves the same entity relation and passes the same acceptance checks.
Stop or reformulate when the intended biological unit cannot be established within budget.
multi_mapping: Retain all supported relations and analyze an explicitly defined grouping rule.
Stratify or exclude ambiguous records only with a predeclared, documented reason and report their count.
legal_alternatives.resource_irrelevant: Do not acquire or maintain mappings that cannot affect the selected claim, unit, or use decision.

non_goals: No universal coverage or conflict threshold.
No automatic resource discovery/download/mapping program in this plan.
No current Yeast input or frozen Harness changes.
No new mapping result, new paper analysis, peer-review reanalysis, or scientific conclusion.
No inference of undocumented decisions or search history from published narratives.

paper_and_review_extraction.evidence_boundary: Reported protocol does not reveal unreported exploration history. Reviewer comments identify questions or requested changes; they do not by themselves prove that a workflow was executed.
paper_and_review_extraction.method: Extract condition/motivation, choice and alternatives, information use, operation, result, and next decision; do not reduce an article to a step list.
planned_materials: available preprint or earlier manuscript version when needed
paper_and_review_extraction.synthesis_rule: Only patterns repeated across independently documented cases may become shared guidance; retain task-specific steps as conditional branches and record conflicts. No numeric cross-case threshold is set in this plan.
paper_and_review_extraction.reconstruction_acceptance: A reconstructed control rule remains a candidate until applied and evaluated in a later research iteration; keep its source rationale and later contrary evidence. It does not retroactively describe the authors actual exploration history.

plan_kind: future design; no implementation or study execution
purpose: Make resource gaps part of a conditional research self-check loop when they can affect the selected claim, evaluation unit, or use decision. Here self-check means the research process checking its own evidence path, not a model self-supervised objective.

current_priority.precedence: first; do not change its frozen inputs or write into its work directory
current_priority.work: continue the already dispatched Yeast VAC follow-up plan in its original thread and frozen Harness input

sequence_and_priority.dependency: Choose the research claim and target unit before searching for maps; run the resource loop only when the missing relation can affect the decision.

future_resource_work.first_model_topic_pilot: Splice gene/family mapping only if a later question makes gene/family-level independence part of the target claim or evaluation unit
future_resource_work.later_scope: after repeated model-topic cases, consider broader methods research

source_and_design_bindings.role: existing conditional guidance on target domain and validation unit; design reference only
existing proxy/similarity and background guidance; not a biological gene map
current public Splice case identity and scope; no new mapping evidence
public source navigation; this plan does not append or rewrite the source index

trigger.examples: Gene/family generalization needs suitable entity links; fixed-window archive prediction may stay at its current proxy unit.
trigger.not_triggered_when: The study remains within a fixed archive unit and the proposed resource would not change its question, evaluation, or decision.
trigger.required: A specific missing entity or annotation relation affects the stated claim, split/grouping unit, evaluation denominator, or intended use.

workflow.acceptance: A concrete decision depends on the resource; otherwise record not triggered.
workflow.obligation: Name the claim and current unit; state the missing entity relation and how it could change grouping, evaluation, interpretation, or use.

workflow.acceptance: The selected source is justified by entity semantics, scope, version, license, and intended evaluation.
alternatives: Use a versioned primary/maintained mapping source.
Keep current proxy groups and narrow the claim.
Stop or reformulate if no source can resolve the intended unit within budget.
workflow.obligation: Compare an appropriate authoritative/versioned source with legitimate alternatives; state permitted license, query scope, time/size budget, expected coverage evidence, and stop condition before acquisition.

workflow.acceptance: Another reader can identify the exact resource snapshot and transformation.
workflow.obligation: Save citation/URL, database or annotation release, retrieval date, license, query/API parameters, raw-response/file identity, and transformation code/config.

workflow.acceptance: Coverage and conflict criteria were selected for the question before outcome comparison; unknown mappings remain unknown, not negative.
workflow.obligation: Distinguish gene, transcript, protein, family, and domain; retain one-to-many and many-to-many relations; inspect unmatched, duplicate, ambiguous, conflicting, and stale identifiers; quantify coverage against the intended denominator.

workflow.acceptance: Evidence shows mapped entities actually entered the split, grouping, or evaluation. An unused mapping table is not a scientific result.
workflow.obligation: Bind every grouping or pairing used to source version, mapping row/relation, output entity, and exact consumer code/config; preserve the prior proxy/unit as comparison where feasible.

workflow.acceptance: The evidence path connects mapping source to consumed identifiers, changed evaluation, and a stated decision; otherwise record limitation/unknown.
workflow.obligation: Compare unit membership, coverage, leakage/overlap checks, performance or use counts, then apply the plan conditions for retaining, narrowing, changing, or stopping the claim.

workflow.acceptance: A successor can see what the relation means, where it came from, how it was used, and what it changed.
workflow.obligation: Explain the biological entity and mapping relation in readable terms; separate source-reported facts, locally observed files, locally executed work, inference, and unknowns.
